text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса enters the ring of the
Twinkle
Series. Her goal? To be the
strongest racer in the
world!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by strong friends like
Спешл Уик
and Грасс Вандер, she
works hard towards her
goal...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All so that she may one day take off for
races
across the world. With a vigorous
shout, El
Condor Pasa prepares to make
her dreams come
true.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
